label: 码头平台
description: 在单张区域掩码上按 point 生成码头平台。Point 吸附最近边界并推导局部外法线；引桥固定向岸内压入 4 格，避免与有机岸线断开，length 仍只表示向水面伸出的长度。尽头接大甲板。电池直接输出专用 tagGrid：岸内端与甲板外侧长边为开口，甲板两个短边不打标、保留栏杆。输出单张合并多值网格（1=甲板，2=引桥）。
description-en: Generate a point-positioned dock platform. The point snaps to the nearest boundary and determines a local outward normal. The approach overlaps four cells inland to prevent shore gaps, while length still measures only the outward run. A dedicated tagGrid marks the inland end and deck's outer long edge as openings; both short deck edges remain rails.
icon: 俯视码头木质平台，一条细长引桥从左侧陆地伸向水面，尽头是一块浅棕色矩形大甲板，扁平插画风格，主色2种。

inputs.name: inputGrid
inputs.label: 区域掩码
inputs.description: 单张可用区域掩码网格（每非零单元格视为陆地）；只用来找岸接线，结构可以长到掩码外。网格列表由引擎逐张 fanout。
inputs.description-en: Single region mask grid (non-zero cells treated as land); used only to locate the shoreline — the structure may grow outside it. The engine fans out a grid list one-by-one.

inputs.name: point
inputs.label: 接岸位置
inputs.description: 期望的接岸 point2d（x→列、y→行）。不在区域边缘时吸附到欧氏距离最近的 4 邻域边界格；伸出方向按吸附点附近的局部岸线自动推导。
inputs.description-en: Desired shore anchor point2d (x→column, y→row). If it is not on the region edge, it snaps to the nearest 4-neighbour boundary cell by Euclidean distance; the outward direction is inferred from the local shoreline.

inputs.name: deckWidth
inputs.label: 甲板宽度
inputs.description: 尽头甲板垂直于伸出方向的宽度（格数），与引桥共用同一中轴。
inputs.description-en: Width in cells of the far-end deck, perpendicular to the growth direction, sharing the walkway's mid axis.

inputs.name: deckDepth
inputs.label: 甲板进深
inputs.description: 尽头甲板沿伸出方向的进深（格数），从引桥末端继续往外铺。建议大于引桥宽度：进深小于等于桥宽时甲板会被端头判定当成一段横桥，两头补上收口块。
inputs.description-en: Depth in cells of the far-end deck along the growth direction, continuing outward from the walkway's tip. Keep it larger than the walkway width: at or below it, end-cap detection reads the deck as another bridge strip and caps its two ends.

inputs.name: width
inputs.label: 引桥宽度
inputs.description: 引桥垂直于伸出方向的宽度（格数），居中放置。同时作为 thickness 输出喂给 bridge_entry_tag。
inputs.description-en: Approach walkway width in cells, perpendicular to the growth direction, centered. Also emitted as `thickness` for bridge_entry_tag.

inputs.name: length
inputs.label: 引桥长度
inputs.description: 引桥从岸接线沿伸出方向的长度（格数）；0=甲板直接贴岸。只被画布边界裁剪，不被岸线裁剪。
inputs.description-en: Approach walkway length in cells from the shoreline along the growth direction; 0 = deck sits directly against the shore. Clipped only by the canvas, never by the shoreline.

outputs.name: outputGrid
outputs.label: 码头平台掩码
outputs.description: 单张多值网格：1=甲板，2=引桥。已是合并后的整片掩码——直接接一个 grid2node.grid 建成单个节点。⚠️ 不要接 grid_split_by_value 拆成多个节点：preview 的 autotile 邻接判断只看本节点自己那一层，拆开会在甲板与引桥交界处长出一圈假扶手。
outputs.description-en: Single multi-value grid: 1=deck, 2=approach. Already the merged mask — wire it into one grid2node.grid to build a single node. ⚠️ Do not split it with grid_split_by_value: the preview's autotile neighbour probe only sees the cell's own layer, so splitting grows a ring of phantom rails where the deck meets the walkway.

outputs.name: tagGrid
outputs.label: 开口标签网格
outputs.description: 与 outputGrid 同尺寸；岸内端和甲板外侧长边标为端头开口，甲板两个短边保持 0 以使用栏杆贴片。接 grid2node.stateGrid。
outputs.description-en: Same size as outputGrid; marks the inland end and deck's outer long edge as openings while leaving both short deck edges untagged for rail tiles. Wire to grid2node.stateGrid.

outputs.name: thickness
outputs.label: 桥宽（给端头判定）
outputs.description: 等于 width，接 bridge_entry_tag.thickness。由电池自己输出是因为端头判定必须知道桥宽，而下游拿不到 width；接死一个常数会在改宽度时失效。
outputs.description-en: Equals `width`; wire into bridge_entry_tag.thickness. Emitted by the battery because end-cap detection needs the bridge width and downstream cannot see `width`; hard-coding a constant silently breaks when the width changes.
